capacity.scope: Local Docker Supabase PG17 and production-mode Next HTTP endpoints; not hosted capacity
capacity.failure: Steady workload exceeded 180-second actionable age and accumulated backlog; stopped arrivals early to measure same-generation drain.
unexecuted: Remaining portion of planned 60-minute arrival phase

derivedMeasurements.rateMethod: First-to-last steady sample counter deltas divided by elapsed minutes; first immediate batch excluded from rate numerator

interruption.scope: Independent actual worker process; real 120-second lease; fixed isolated upgrade Docker stack

temporal.scope: Local PostgREST, real elapsed windows; synthetic future SLA deadline; immediate extra calls test cursor correctness, not scheduled throughput

controls.scope: Separate production-mode Next HTTP server and Docker recovery database; real SSR cookie session

upgrade.scope: Local Supabase PG17; synthetic owner-seeded history for constraint scans, not executed action effects

restore.method: Supabase CLI schema/data/history; replica-mode transaction; managed vector tables excluded
restore.scope: Isolated local restore; no hosted platform configuration or Storage object bytes restored

observability.scope: Local Next server log and PostgreSQL stdout/stderr log sample; not provider-wide log sinks
observability.workerInvocationLink: PARTIAL: worker step logs omit the automation_runs UUID; associate by bounded invocation time, not an exact persisted foreign key

releaseDecision: BLOCKED: steady workload fails; hosted-specific, full UI/screen-reader and operational-matrix gaps remain; no activation

ui.scope: Real local Safari; documented manual observations
ui.screenReader: BLOCKED; incomplete spoken workflow audit; VoiceOver OFF at owner request
